seo_title: The Cozy Cactus | Family Stay with Hot Tub in Indio, CA
seo_description: Family stay in Indio with baby gear, sound machines, a private hot tub, putting green, and shared community pools. Three bedrooms sleep up to eight.
tagline: Less to pack, more time together.
description_heading: The family gear is already here.
description_p1: Traveling with kids comes with enough luggage. The Cozy Cactus has a pack ’n play, Stokke high chair, changing pad, and sound machines in every bedroom.
description_p2: The kitchen drawers are labeled, the toys and board games are ready, and there’s a full kitchen and laundry for the everyday stuff.
description_p3: Three bedrooms and two bathrooms accommodate up to eight guests. Outside, you’ll find a putting green, covered patio, and private hot tub.
description_p4: You also have access to three shared community pools at Indian Palms Country Club. The Cozy Cactus is pet-free and smoke-free.
